answer: Consider Proof of unique surf lifesaving award with lifesaving society attestation as the gate. With an award the society renews after requalification in place, the tide an attacker faces is not a puzzle to solve once but a cost paid per identity. Time is the tax here: an award the society renews after requalification cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the lagoon for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of. The river is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
